title: 01. Foundations: LoRA — Low-Rank Adaptation
summary: LoRA freezes all original model weights and adds small trainable "adapter" matrices that capture the fine-tuning changes. You only train the adapters — typically 1-10% of parameters.

sections.title: What Is LoRA?
sections.body: > **LoRA freezes all original model weights and adds small trainable "adapter" matrices that capture the fine-tuning changes. You only train the adapters — typically 1-10% of parameters.**

sections.title: LoRA Architecture — Deep Dive
sections.body:
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                   LoRA ARCHITECTURE                             │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

  WITHOUT LoRA (full fine-tuning):
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Input x
    │
    ▼
  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │  W (4096×4096 = 16.7M params)           │  ← ALL updated
  │  TRAINABLE                               │    during training
  └─────────────────────────────────────────┘
    │
    ▼
  Output = Wx

  WITH LoRA:
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Input x
    │
    ├────────────────────────────────────────┐
    │                                        │
    ▼                                        ▼
  ┌─────────────────────────────────┐   ┌───────┐   ┌───────┐
  │  W (4096×4096 = 16.7M params)   │   │   B   │   │   A   │
  │  FROZEN ❄️ (not trained)         │   │4096×r │   │ r×4096│
  └────────────────┬────────────────┘   └───┬───┘   └───┬───┘
                   │                        │  r=8        │
                   │                        ▼             │
                   │               ┌────────────────┐     │
                   │               │  BA (low-rank  │  ←──┘
                   │               │  approximation)│
                   │               │  TRAINABLE ✅  │
                   │               └───────┬────────┘
                   │                       │
                   ▼                       ▼
                  Wx  ──────────────────► + ──► Output = Wx + BAx
                                              ↑
                                     ONLY BA is trained!

  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  KEY PARAMETERS:
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  r (RANK): controls adapter size and capacity
  ┌────────┬─────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │  r=4   │  Tiny. 0.02% of params. Minimal capacity.      │
  │  r=8   │  Small. 0.05%. Good for simple tasks. ← common │
  │  r=16  │  Medium. 0.1%. Most fine-tuning tasks. ← sweet │
  │  r=32  │  Large. 0.2%. Complex tasks.                   │
  │  r=64  │  Very large. 0.4%. When data is abundant.      │
  │  r=128 │  Huge. 0.8%. Near-full fine-tuning territory.  │
  └────────┴─────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

  alpha (SCALING FACTOR):
  Controls learning rate of LoRA weights.
  Output = Wx + (alpha/r) × BAx
  Typical: alpha = r (ratio = 1.0)
  Or:      alpha = 2×r (ratio = 2.0, stronger learning)
  Rule: higher alpha = LoRA learns faster (can overfit)

  WHICH LAYERS TO APPLY LoRA TO:
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  In transformer attention block:
  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │  q_proj (Query)      ← most impactful              ✅   │
  │  k_proj (Key)        ← important                   ✅   │
  │  v_proj (Value)      ← most impactful              ✅   │
  │  o_proj (Output)     ← important                   ✅   │
  │  gate_proj (FFN)     ← add for complex tasks       ✅   │
  │  up_proj (FFN)       ← add for complex tasks       ✅   │
  │  down_proj (FFN)     ← add for complex tasks       ✅   │
  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
  Minimum: q_proj + v_proj
  Standard: all attention + FFN layers

  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  MEMORY COMPARISON: Full FT vs LoRA (7B model)
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  Full Fine-Tuning:    LoRA (r=16):
  Model: 28 GB         Model (frozen): 14 GB (FP16)
  Grads: 28 GB         LoRA weights:    0.1 GB
  Adam:  56 GB         Grads (LoRA):    0.1 GB
  Act:   10 GB         Adam (LoRA):     0.2 GB
  Total: 122 GB        Activations:    10 GB
                       Total:          24 GB ✅ fits in 1× RTX 4090!

  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  MERGING LoRA BACK:
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  After training: merge LoRA weights into base model.
  W_merged = W + (alpha/r) × B × A

  BEFORE MERGE:                AFTER MERGE:
  2 files (base + LoRA)        1 file (merged)
  Slightly slower inference    Full speed inference
  Easy to swap adapters        Can't swap back
  Swap different tasks         One task baked in
```
